decisions.title: Product architecture
decisions.selected: Local-first Python platform with domain/services separated from PySide6 HUD and FastAPI/CLI surfaces; optional native kernels only after profiling.
decisions.consequence: Core calculations remain independently testable and UI/provider adapters cannot define poker semantics.

decisions.title: Authoritative numeric representation
decisions.selected: Use integer minor/chip units where possible and Decimal/rational-style exact arithmetic for authoritative pot/amount formulas; floats are permitted for simulation/optimization with explicit tolerance.
alternatives: Use Decimal everywhere including hot simulation loops
decisions.consequence: Money/pot identities are stable while performance-sensitive probability code remains practical.

decisions.title: Statistics model
decisions.selected: Define statistics as versioned opportunity + success + dimensions and generate contextual variants through a DSL instead of hard-coding every stat permutation.
alternatives: One database column per HUD stat
decisions.consequence: The system can support hundreds of base metrics and thousands of contextual variants with testable denominators.

decisions.title: Solver truthfulness
decisions.selected: Use CFR correctness ladder and explicit abstractions/re-solving/imported strategies; every result is labeled by source/abstraction/convergence and exact-GTO claims are prohibited unless actually justified.
decisions.consequence: Solver work remains scientifically testable and does not contaminate educational output with false certainty.

decisions.title: Recommendation structure
decisions.selected: Decision output keeps baseline strategy, exploit adjustment, EV analysis, uncertainty, and sensitivity as separate layers.
decisions.consequence: Users can learn why a decision changes and can distinguish theory from opponent-specific exploitation.

decisions.title: Live integration boundary
decisions.selected: Live mode consumes a structured, validated adapter contract when available; post-session analysis remains fully functional without live integration. OCR/screen scraping is not a foundational dependency.
decisions.consequence: The core remains portable and testable while venue-specific integration is isolated.
